name: What is the standard step-by-step process of a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the standard step-by-step process of a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen remodel typically follows five clear phases: demolition, rough-in work, surface preparation, finish installations, and final punch-list detailing. First, old cabinets, fixtures, and surfaces are removed. Next, plumbing and electrical lines are run, followed by wall framing, drywall hanging, taping, and texturing. Once walls are prepped, cabinets, trim molding, tile backsplashes, and paint are installed. Abraham Becerra acts as the hands-on project lead, directly managing carpentry and tile while coordinating trades on-site to keep the renovation running smoothly through completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves demolition, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall and framing, cabinet and tile installation, followed by finish trim, painting, and fixture hookups.
